grafana-dashboards-provider.content:
apiVersion: 1
providers:
  - name: atlas-local
    type: file
    updateIntervalSeconds: 30
    options:
      path: /var/lib/grafana/dashboards
      foldersFromFilesStructure: false
grafana-dashboards-provider.name: atlas-local_grafana-dashboards-provider

grafana-datasources.content:
apiVersion: 1
datasources:
  - name: Atlas Prometheus (local)
    uid: atlas-prometheus
    type: prometheus
    access: proxy
    url: http://prometheus:9090
    isDefault: true
grafana-datasources.name: atlas-local_grafana-datasources

prometheus-local-config.content:
global:
  scrape_interval: 15s
  evaluation_interval: 15s
scrape_configs:
  - job_name: atlas-api
    metrics_path: /metrics
    static_configs:
      - targets: ["api:8080"]
  - job_name: prometheus
    static_configs:
      - targets: ["localhost:9090"]
prometheus-local-config.name: atlas-local_prometheus-local-config

command: python /app/deploy/mtls/local_ca.py check --root /mtls/pki --role api && exec uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080 --ssl-keyfile /mtls/pki/api/key.pem --ssl-certfile /mtls/pki/api/cert.pem --ssl-ca-certs /mtls/pki/api/ca.pem --ssl-cert-reqs 2

mkdir -p /run/atlas-postgres; cp /mtls/pki/postgres/* /run/atlas-postgres/; chown -R postgres:postgres /run/atlas-postgres; chmod 600 /run/atlas-postgres/key.pem; exec docker-entrypoint.sh postgres -c ssl=on -c ssl_cert_file=/run/atlas-postgres/cert.pem -c ssl_key_file=/run/atlas-postgres/key.pem -c ssl_ca_file=/run/atlas-postgres/ca.pem -c hba_file=/run/atlas-postgres/pg_hba.conf

mkdir -p /run/atlas-redis; cp /mtls/pki/redis/* /run/atlas-redis/; chown -R redis:redis /run/atlas-redis; chmod 600 /run/atlas-redis/key.pem; exec docker-entrypoint.sh redis-server --appendonly yes --requirepass "$${REDIS_PASSWORD}" --port 0 --tls-port 6379 --tls-cert-file /run/atlas-redis/cert.pem --tls-key-file /run/atlas-redis/key.pem --tls-ca-cert-file /run/atlas-redis/ca.pem --tls-auth-clients yes
python /app/deploy/mtls/local_ca.py check --root /mtls/pki --role worker && exec python -m app.workers.celery_tls_config

atlas-loki-local.content:
auth_enabled: false
server:
  http_listen_port: 3100
common:
  path_prefix: /loki
  replication_factor: 1
  ring:
    kvstore:
      store: inmemory
  storage:
    filesystem:
      chunks_directory: /loki/chunks
      rules_directory: /loki/rules
schema_config:
  configs:
    - from: "2024-01-01"
      store: tsdb
      object_store: filesystem
      schema: v13
      index:
        prefix: index_
        period: 24h
limits_config:
  retention_period: 72h
compactor:
  working_directory: /loki/compactor
  retention_enabled: true
  delete_request_store: filesystem
analytics:
  reporting_enabled: false
atlas-loki-local.name: atlas-local_atlas-loki-local

command: export CELERY_BROKER_URL="$$(python -m app.workers.celery_broker_config --print-url)" && exec uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080
export CELERY_BROKER_URL="$$(python -m app.workers.celery_broker_config --print-url)" && exec celery -A app.workers.celery_app:celery_app worker --loglevel=INFO
